summary: Use and update lastIndex for global RegExp execution.

target.notes: With g, search begins at ToLength(lastIndex), may scan forward, and successful execution sets lastIndex to the UTF-16 end index.

caveats: lastIndex is state carried across different input strings until reset or overwritten.

tests.name: global uses current index
tests.input: const r=/a/g; r.lastIndex=1; const m=r.exec('baac'); console.log(m.index,r.lastIndex);

tests.name: global scans after start
tests.input: const r=/a/g; r.lastIndex=1; const m=r.exec('bba'); console.log(m.index,r.lastIndex);
